static_checks: Both exact source bodies parse with Python ast.parse; no product import or runtime execution.

TypedStateOwnerGateway._execute_current_source_read retains original lock, connection, service, store/CAS, owner/binding bytes and continuation registry before the first source clock. Every detached callback interval closes against these original witnesses.

The initial grants-lock capture resolves the unique issued native source grant and peer identity without sampling a clock. Actual expiry is required after the detached admission sample; renewal completed before a request is accepted, while replacement during a read refuses.

Admission, post-replay and closing source clock samples run outside SERVER and the grants lock. _require_active_grant receives the checked sample for this path; unrelated calls retain their existing default behavior.
Exact connection.in_transaction is False at capture and closing boundaries, in addition to the wire handler's transaction_active refusal. No SQL transaction is created to probe transaction state.

Private prepare/replay/stage/close/publish require the same active state. Gateway locals independently pin original state witnesses, actual restored inventory identity and selected/response witnesses; finish accepts no caller-supplied restored inventory.

CAS replay uses the original reader outside SERVER. Native generation/fence/database UUID, task revision/body, complete committed population and selected working bytes close under the original lock after callbacks.

Closing authorization repeats active-grant validation after source authorization and after final native/source checks. Cursor pruning, predecessor consumption and successor publication occur only after that closing boundary.
Publication derives the predecessor from the byte-pinned payload continuation, removing the mutable state.cursor bypass. Original registry reference and contents must match until publication.
Compatibility execute samples its final clock, then repeats _close_read before publishing. Both gateway and compatibility paths discard only their original active state on refusal.

The gateway busy guard is held only for marker entry/exit. Nested or concurrent reads refuse promptly; finally clears only its own ticket. Refusal neither consumes a predecessor nor rolls back an external transaction this read did not create.
preserved_contracts: Existing request/response/binding schemas, exact payload fields, canonical request byte/CID/path/integer bounds and source-only grants remain.
Private issued continuation registry, grant-bound cursor CID, millisecond expiry, capacity, one-use predecessor and cross-grant rejection remain; no public dictionary becomes authority.
Complete envelope bounds, conservative slicing, UTF8/base64/empty-source behavior, byte/wire fixed-point accounting and explicit unresolved frontier remain.
Existing native reader binding and consumed-after-failure admission/allocation markers remain; no replacement owner, grant, database or rebind fallback is introduced.
remaining_limits: Initial native bind still constructs CurrentSourceLookup and performs constructor CAS replay under SERVER. It remains a separate implementation and qualification gap.
Detached lock safety is established by source inspection for the wire gateway path. A compatibility caller choosing to hold its own external lock around execute is not covered by this claim.
Current-source checks are sequential, not a writer lease or atomic filesystem snapshot. This review does not authenticate arbitrary replacement runtime methods or every dependency/import.

Direct source SDK native task/body checks do not confer coordinator claims, nominated allocation custody, provider execution, proof authority or separately deployed worker UID permissions. Existing broker/native parents retain their separate checks.

Host fixtures and authored deployment metadata cannot establish cross-process permission custody, coding-child admission, measured complete model usage or token savings. Actual transport failure and incurred-byte behavior require runtime qualification.
